description: Flux/Kubernetes archetype for GitOps repos. Scopes the flux + kubernetes managers to workload manifests, groups OpenTelemetry, and suppresses kubernetes-api deprecation noise.

packageRules.description: Disable Kubernetes apiVersion deprecation tracking. Scoping the kubernetes manager to apps/ and common/ makes it emit a kubernetes-api dep per resource kind, which only adds dashboard noise. We only want container images from this manager.
Group OpenTelemetry components together (collector + operator move in lockstep), separate from the general minor/patch batch.
